rv.q: Shakespeare lives in the here and now -- but also forever, thanks to a production that will become an instant part of theatrical folklore.
In Scott, he has a Hamlet for the ages, a performance that will go down in history.
The lack of melodic muscle may well hamper Hamlet ‘s chances of entering the repertory, for while there’s plenty to admire, what’s to love?
Much like this show as a whole.

cn.t: Andrew Scott's Hamlet earns widespread acclaim as a sensational, revelatory performance in Robert Icke's triumphant production, though not all stagings this season meet the same high bar.
